news.title: Living weather and layered magic
news.body: Animated flame sprites now burn along the screen edges, with layered mist, flowing blue/violet magic and moving motes. Rain has brighter streaks and larger droplets; frost adds foreground snow. Effects can continue around combat: buttons, health readouts and QTE panels are kept clear using their current screen positions. Weather/lens toggles, still/off settings and reduced motion are respected. Timing, scoring and controller controls are unchanged. Installer is separate.

news.title: Phone combat: centered taps and press feedback
news.body: Phone charge, strike, block, counter and capture prompts now anchor to the visible screen, including browser zoom and viewport changes. Timing buttons show an inset press and a ripple where your finger lands. Reduced-motion mode uses a static highlight. Timing windows, scoring and controller mappings are unchanged. Installed-app launch repair remains included. No reinstall or data reset is needed.

news.title: Home-screen app launch fix
news.body: The installed app now starts at /play. Older home-screen shortcuts using /index.html are redirected to the game when player access is open, and to the welcome page when it is closed. The app identity, same-site storage, linked progress and admin access are unchanged. No reinstall or data reset is needed. The online counter still reflects recent social-service check-ins, not total visitors or proof that an offline/background app is closed.

news.title: Living magic: the frame comes alive
news.body: Browser hotfix 9 adds illustrated menu and panel backgrounds, flowing cyan and violet energy, sizzling edge sparks and arcane frames. Between actions, small portals can send a reaching gauntlet toward the screen, or rain, fire embers and lightning can visit the edges. Surprise events stay clear of visible controls and pause during battles, QTEs, minigames, travel and dialogs. Phones use fewer particles and longer intervals. Settings now offers Living magic, Still artwork and Off; device reduced motion and existing weather preferences are respected. Controller mappings, centered phone timing, damage, capture odds and progression are unchanged. Linked progress and admin access are preserved. This is a browser update; the installer remains separate.

news.title: Phone combat: one clear place to tap
news.body: Browser hotfix 8 puts phone strike, charge, block and counter prompts in a large centered panel. Tap the same middle button when the marker reaches the bright band. Soul Capture stays in that same central spot: hold the ring, then release in the light. Touching outside the guard button no longer spends the attempt. Prompts stay centered in portrait and landscape, independent of battlefield scrolling. Controller and keyboard timing inputs and combat scoring are unchanged. The public welcome page now has an animated portal, illustrated patch notes, and features covering trading, crafting, companions and guild PvP. Motion can be paused. Linked progress and admin access are preserved; the installer remains separate.

news.title: A brighter doorway, clearer battles and your first journey
news.body: Build 28 browser hotfix 7 is live. The starting screen has a brighter gold, violet and cyan portal. Check Mysterious Portal can bring rain, a blood echo, a burning scroll, a passing spirit, or a quiet moment; these are visual effects, not rewards. Pause portal motion is available, and reduced motion gives text responses. Phone combat has compact companion portraits, readable enemy names and at least 44px command buttons. Guard timing keeps its own full-height row. Map names are larger: swipe to pan, or use controller directions to select a location. Unvisited places stay hidden by mist; discovering a portal clears a larger local area. The opening journey has shorter guidance, optional location details and a less crowded menu. The approved Keeper 030 idle/walk art and registered Thornhog art are included. Existing attack/capture animations and gameplay rules remain. Controls: L1/LB Keeper menu, R1/RB next named panel, D-pad/left stick select, right stick cursor, Cross/A confirm, Circle/B back. In combat, Triangle/Y abilities, Square/X items; contextual targeting, guard and timed prompts remain. Linked cloud saves and admin access are preserved. The Windows online client receives the hosted update; its installer stays separate.

news.title: Rift cursor and clearer controller navigation
news.body: D-pad and left stick now snap between buttons within a screen panel. L1/LB opens the Keeper menu. Outside that menu, R1/RB moves to the next panel; the top button names it. Inside the Keeper menu, R1 closes it. Move the right stick to use the rift cursor, then Cross/A to choose under it. D-pad or left stick returns to button selection. Click the right stick (R3) to toggle the cursor, or use Settings. L2/R2 still scroll pages. Outside combat, Triangle/Y opens companions and Square/X opens the nearby tavern or discovered portal. Combat, targeting, guard and timed-action controls keep their existing mappings. This browser update includes the portrait combat layout, ability popups, account linking and cloud saves. The installer stays separate.

news.title: Unique Keeper names and account linking
news.body: Keeper names are now checked by the server. Duplicate names, reserved staff names and common profanity are blocked, including common spelling disguises. Existing duplicate or restricted names receive a unique temporary Keeper name while their identity and progress remain intact. The original creator Keeper keeps its name and admin role. Guest identity now survives closing and reopening the browser. Link the Keeper on the device with the progress you want to keep, then sign in on another device and choose Continue cloud Keeper. This update is for the browser game; the installer is unchanged.

news.title: Portrait battles, updated controls and cloud saves
news.body:
New battle view: enemies occupy the upper scene, party portraits sit below, and the active Keeper, companion or enemy gets a large central portrait. The command menu stays below your portraits. Tap commands on phone or use Cross / A to select, Triangle / Y for Abilities, Square / X for Items and Circle / B to return. Abilities and Items replace the main command menu. Circle never withdraws; use Withdraw deliberately. Solo: left/right select targets, up/down select commands; L1 guards, R1 cycles targets, R2 captures. Shared battles: L1 / R1 cycle targets and directional input selects commands. Timed-action prompts keep their existing controls.

Account linking and cloud saves: on the browser with the progress you want to keep, open Account & cloud saves and choose Link this Keeper. Create a private account and download your recovery code. On another browser or phone, sign in and choose Continue cloud Keeper. Do not link a new duplicate character first. Existing progress stays on your device until you link it; conflicts preserve both copies for your choice. Existing admin access follows the linked account. This update changes the browser game only; the downloadable installer is separate.

news.title: New Keeper menu - more world, less scrolling
news.body: The scrolling sidebar has been replaced by the Keeper menu. Press L1 / LB, or select Menu at the top of the screen. Choose a group, then a destination. D-pad or left stick moves; Cross / A selects; Circle / B steps back and closes from the group list. L1 / LB or R1 / RB closes the menu. Use Previous / Next for additional destinations. Combat, targeting and timed-action controls are unchanged. Keyboard: Escape opens the menu, arrows move, Enter selects, Escape steps back. Mouse and touch: use Menu and the labelled buttons.

news.title: Build 28: through the next door
news.body: New Keeper motion, combat portraits, grounded creatures, weather, Codex and riverside workshop presentation.
